card.name: Second digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that completes a two-digit or longer number, right after the first digit. It is seen in numbered tables, price figures, reference indexes and data values.

modes.label: Table row numbers
modes.description: Last digit of a weight or row number in an atomic-weight style list.
modes.example: An atom of nitrous acid, 1 nitric acid + 1 nitrous gas||3<<1>>| |35.||An atom

modes.label: Prices and data values
modes.description: Final digit of a dollar amount or measured value.
modes.example: $2<<9>> without the number. See chart below.

modes.label: Citation and result numbers
modes.description: Last digit inside verse, index or result figures.

card.plain: It fires on the second digit of a number that is still being written out, as in tables and lists of figures.
